school.corporation_name: 愛知県厚生農業協同組合連合会

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find a FY2026 target confirmation form from an official-index-linked school support news page where the page text supplies the rolling-year evidence.
search_queries: 愛北看護専門学校 令和8年度 修学支援新制度 確認申請書
愛北看護専門学校 機関要件確認申請書
steps: Open the Aichi official-index artifact row for 愛知県厚生農業協同組合連合会 愛北看護専門学校.
Follow the official-index link to https://www.jaaikosei.or.jp/aihokukansen/news/高等教育の修学支援制度について/.
Read the school support page statement 令和８年度より本校も支援対象となります.
Follow the adjacent link labeled 確認申請書様式第２号.
Accept the PDF because the official page supplies FY2026 target-year evidence and the PDF body contains 愛北看護専門学校 plus 様式第２号.

expected_result.disclosure_url: https://www.jaaikosei.or.jp/aihokukansen/news/高等教育の修学支援制度について/

reusable_rules: Treat an official-index-linked support page statement such as 令和８年度より本校も支援対象 as strong FY2026 evidence when it is local to a 確認申請書様式第２号 link.
Accept a PDF whose filename still contains an old marker such as r7 only when the page context supplies target-year evidence and the PDF body contains the school name plus 様式第２号.
Preserve pattern_type=wordpress for the /wp-content/uploads/ PDF so future extraction changes cannot silently reclassify this delivery path.
anti_patterns: Do not accept the old-year-looking filename by itself; the FY2026 evidence comes from the adjacent official page text.
Do not use unrelated future dates in the PDF body as target fiscal-year evidence.

source_paths: https://www.jaaikosei.or.jp/aihokukansen/news/高等教育の修学支援制度について/
evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-13 found the official-index-linked page statement 令和８年度より本校も支援対象となります. Source-side PDF text extraction verified 愛北看護専門学校 and 様式第２号 in the PDF body.
